title: 第11章 禁莲第12章 真武圣地 灭
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 凌浩的话，瞬间让清芝儿如同晴天霹雳一般瘫软在地上，脸上上充满了绝望，根本不知道自己为什么会遭受到如此的灭顶之灾
“为什么，我们圣地与你无冤无仇，为什么你要灭掉我们，我们从头到尾就没有任何交集，你为什么要这么做？”
清芝儿嘶哑的对凌浩呐喊道，眼里充满着不甘与泪水
“为什么？呵呵，弱是原罪”
凌浩冷漠的看着跪在地上的清芝儿道，眼神中没有任何感情
前世凌家被灭，凌浩一人跪在在黑魔顶峰上撕心裂肺的呐喊着为什么，凌家从屹立三千大世界开始就一直在守护人界，最后就因为得罪所谓的位面之子而受到魂飞魄散的下场，上百万的凌家弟子都陨落
而后的最后一战
帝域之巅上，凌浩问叶辰为什么要灭我凌家，叶辰的回答是
“弱是原罪”
当时的凌浩感觉这个世界是何等的讽刺
“弱是原罪吗？呵呵呵”
清芝儿自嘲的道，手紧紧的握着青色莲衣，内心充满着不甘，但那又能怎么样呢？自己能赢眼前的十岁孩童吗？
真武大陆一处
真武圣地附属皇朝上空
上空出一道金色的身影，翻掌使向脚下的皇朝，一道万丈巨掌冲向皇朝
“这到底是怎么回事，快速开启护国大阵！！！”
皇朝内一名身穿五爪金龙帝袍看着天空呐喊道
而后，整个万丈巨掌落下，整个皇朝就此陨灭在历史的长河之中，留下的就只有一个巨大的掌印
同一时间
整个真武大陆都发生震动，四处皆是灾难般的爆炸声，惊动了真武大陆的各大势力，纷纷下令封山，闭教，不得弟子外出
真武圣地大门外
“这巨大的爆炸声是怎么回事，为什么爆炸的方向都是我们圣地附属皇朝的方向？”
两名刚刚历练回来的弟子看向天空道
“不清楚，算了，还是先回去领任务奖励吧”
而后步入眼帘的是
整个圣地满地都是尸体，有人有异兽，就连看护神兽玄龟也横死在道场上，整个广场被血染红，宛如地狱场景，整个道场横尸遍野，有的尸体被震成一滩烂泥
一名弟子看着眼前的场景瞬间呕吐不止，并跪地着
另一名弟子整个人瘫软在地上，满脸不可置信的看着眼前的一切，内心充满着绝望
大殿内
六十二名金色帝卫陆陆续续的出现在宫殿内
“启禀神子，不辱使命，所有的附属皇朝以及这个地方的弟子全部灭杀”
一名金甲帝卫恭敬的道
“什么？”
下面的武鸿升绝望的看向金甲帝卫道，而后扩散神识笼罩整个圣地，随后看见除了尸体就还是尸体，还有被染红的大地
“不，为什么！！父皇母后啊！！”
叶开嘶吼道，然后燃烧自己的寿元，身上的气息不断攀升，修为瞬间来到了炼婴期巅峰，，原本黑色的头发，瞬间转化成白色的头发，眼中充满着无尽的杀气，手中显现一把漆黑大刀，整个刀身伴随着巨大的戾气，直冲向凌浩
“黑魔.灭世一刀”
content_en:
Ling Hao's words instantly made Qing Zhi'er collapse to the ground like a bolt from the blue. Her face was full of despair. She had no idea why she suffered such a disaster.
"Why, our Holy Land has no enmity with you, why do you want to destroy us? We have never had any intersection from the beginning to the end, why do you do this?"
Qing Zhi'er shouted hoarsely to Ling Hao, her eyes filled with unwillingness and tears.
"Why? Haha, weakness is the original sin."
Ling Hao looked at Qing Zhi'er who was kneeling on the ground indifferently, without any emotion in his eyes.
In the previous life, the Ling family was destroyed. Ling Hao knelt on the top of the Black Demon Peak and screamed heartbreakingly. Why? The Ling family has been protecting the human world since it stood in the Three Thousand Worlds. In the end, because of offending the so-called son of the plane, he suffered a terrible end. Millions of Ling family disciples perished.
And then the final battle
On the top of the Imperial Domain, Ling Hao asked Ye Chen why he wanted to destroy my Ling family. Ye Chen's answer was
"Weakness is the original sin"
At that time, Ling Hao felt how ironic the world was.
"Is weakness the original sin? Hahaha"
Qing Zhi'er said mockingly, holding the green lotus clothes tightly in her hands, her heart full of reluctance, but so what? Can I beat the ten-year-old child in front of me?
A place in Zhenwu Continent
The sky above the Imperial Dynasty affiliated with Zhenwu Holy Land
"Destroy"
A golden figure appeared in the sky, turned his palm towards the Dynasty at his feet, and rushed towards the Dynasty with a huge palm.
"What the hell is going on? Start the national defense formation quickly!!!"
A member of the imperial dynasty wearing a five-clawed golden dragon emperor's robe looked at the sky and shouted
Then, the entire giant palm fell, and the entire dynasty perished in the long river of history, leaving only a huge palm print.
at the same time
The entire Zhenwu Continent was shaken, and there were catastrophic explosions everywhere. This alarmed all the major forces in the Zhenwu Continent, and they ordered the mountains to be closed, schools closed, and no disciples allowed to go out.
Outside the gate of Zhenwu Holy Land
"What's going on with this huge explosion? Why are the directions of the explosions all in the direction of the dynasty affiliated with our Holy Land?"
Two disciples who had just returned from training looked at the sky and said
"I don't know, forget it, let's go back and collect the mission reward first."
Then what came into view was
The whole holy land was full of corpses. Some people had strange beasts. Even the guardian beast Xuangui died in the dojo. The whole square was stained red with blood, like a scene from hell. The entire dojo was littered with corpses, and some corpses were shaken into a puddle of mud.
Ugh~~
A disciple instantly vomited when he saw the scene in front of him and knelt down.
Another disciple collapsed on the ground, looking at everything in front of him with disbelief, and his heart was filled with despair.
In the main hall
Sixty-two golden imperial guards appeared in the palace one after another.
"In order to honor the Son of God, I will fulfill my mission and kill all the subordinate dynasties and the disciples in this place."
A golden-armored imperial guard said respectfully
"What?"
Wu Hongsheng below looked at the Golden Armor Emperor Wei Dao in despair, and then spread his consciousness to cover the entire holy land. Then he saw corpses, corpses, and the earth dyed red.
"No, why!! Father, Queen and Mother!!"
Ye Kai roared, and then burned his life essence, the aura on his body continued to rise, and his cultivation instantly reached the peak of the infant refining stage. His original black hair turned into white hair instantly, his eyes were filled with endless murderous intent, and a black sword appeared in his hand. The entire blade was accompanied by huge violent energy and rushed towards Ling Hao.
"Dark Devil. One knife to destroy the world"
